issues.where: all shots with marks on footage (ch02-s02, ch04-s01, ch04-s03, ch05-s02, ch05-s03, ch05-s04, ch06-s01)
issues.problem: The script asks for 'kit bracket braces snap around' a chip, an input, a PR #3 badge, '67ms' and a Root Cause clause, plus red-pink underlines and highlights on product text. Every kit painter (bracket, kinetic, pill, typed, underline strokes) draws on the scene canvas, and the canvas sits UNDER the DOM RrwebScreen. These marks would be hidden behind the footage. Also, kit bracket wraps its own text; it cannot frame an arbitrary rectangle.
issues.fix: Add one line to the script's shared notes. Every mark that sits on product footage (braces around a rect, underline, highlight wipe, ribbon plates over the player, the screenshot frame) is drawn in shot.overlay() (SVG, above the DOM), positioned in recording px through the screen's crop and zoom, and lands only after the tilt has settled flat. Route a kit need to the shots stage: an SVG bracketRect / underline twin of the canvas painters.

issues.problem: The plane order is inverted by the engine. The 'back plane' ghost is a DOM RrwebScreen, so it renders ABOVE the canvas haze tint and ABOVE the 104 px kit typed URL, which the script calls the 'front plane'. The URL would sit behind a 35 % ghost and the haze would not tint it. The film's one whip also only moves the canvas: the DOM ghost crossfades in place while the frame whips.
issues.fix: Give the ghost CSS style {filter: 'blur(16px)', opacity: 0.25}, and draw the typed URL and the haze tint in shot.overlay() (SVG text with an SVG caret), or replace the ghost with a canvas-drawn input bar. Start the ghost's opacity at 0 and ramp it in only after the 0.45 s whip has landed.

The grey caption 'No test suite required. Complements the one you have.' (53 chars, 4.4 s of the 5.9 s it needs) nearly repeats L0202 and competes with the real page copy. The register is one idea per beat.
issues.fix: Do the shrink in the SVG overlay and fade it out as the take's own typed URL appears (tape 2966). Cut the caption to 'No test suite required.' or drop it: the page's real 'quick chat' sub-copy plus the underline already makes the point.

strengths: Every product shot names its take, its tape window and its marks, and stays inside what the recording really contains. For example, bug-react is held at 3040-3200 to avoid the 3032 jump and the white player at ≈ 3217, and the empty exploration player is honestly plated rather than faked.

The film translates the reference's devices faithfully, and each device has a Replay QA subject: the dawn kinetic line, '{ intro▢▢▢ducing }' with product stamps, the giant typed URL with its caret, the resolving step list, the fanned collage, and the ember end card.

ch05-s02's frame ribbon is the best visual idea in the script: a 67 ms bar covering exactly four 16.7 ms slots, which go hollow while the music stops for four beats. It makes 'dropped frames' felt as missing time, which is the brief's time-only bug made visible.

Type is tied to words and downbeats through beats anchored on narration words, with clear motion vocabulary (blur-in, colour sweep, brace part and snap). The one dark brand register is held back for the time-travel turn, as look.md asks.

The subtle agent beat is correctly small (scale 0.6, bottom-right, unnarrated), generic and grounded. It uses the same ▶ recording chip object that runs through the film, from the run rows to the frame ribbon to the agent hand-off to the end card.
